| # Lifetime {#lifetime-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"} |                                                                                                                                                           |
+-----------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

RCs are designed for a defined lifetime as shown in the following table, depending on the temperature profiles given in [Temperature profile](temperatureprofileofthecontrolunit.html){.topiclink}:

+------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+
|                  | Temperature profile T1                         | Temperature profile T2                         | Temperature profile T3                         |
+==================+================================================+================================================+================================================+
| Storage time     | 5 years                                                                                                                                          |
+------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+
| Service lifetime | 20 years operation /                           | 20 years operation /                           | 20 years operation /                           |
|                  |                                                |                                                |                                                |
|                  | 20 000 operating hours, whichever occurs first | 20 000 operating hours, whichever occurs first | 10 000 operating hours, whichever occurs first |
+------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------+

Please contact Bosch Rexroth (see [Impressum)](impressum.html){.topiclink} if a prolonged operating time is required.

+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ![Warning](warning.png){style="margin:0;width:8.3333in;height:0.4583in;border:none"}                                                                        |
+=============================================================================================================================================================+
| Beyond the given lifetime, failure probabilities may increase and the [reliability parameters](reliabilityparameters.html){.topiclink} cannot be guaranteed |
|                                                                                                                                                             |
| •The ASW shall control the elapsed operating hours regularly by querying the information from the BSW.                                                      |
|                                                                                                                                                             |
| •The ASW shall inform the machine operator accordingly.                                                                                                     |
+-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
